residualRisks.title: Enterprise identity, policy decisions, and brand changes are strongly authenticated and auditable
residualRisks.residualRisk: Password-only access and incomplete audit attribution cannot satisfy higher-assurance tenants.

residualRisks.title: Global collaboration obeys tenant policy, accessibility, retention, and complete attribution
residualRisks.residualRisk: Cross-region or external collaboration can violate policy even when the interface behaves correctly.

residualRisks.title: Literal client API calls resolve to route handlers
residualRisks.residualRisk: Visible controls can call nonexistent endpoints and silently fail.

residualRisks.title: Large projects, long transcripts, collaboration fan-out, and cockpit interaction stay within measured budgets
residualRisks.residualRisk: The cockpit can become unusable as assets, comments, transcript tokens, and collaborators grow.

residualRisks.title: Every journey has automated and keyboard accessibility proof
residualRisks.residualRisk: Existing screenshots or manual notes are not commit-bound executable evidence.

residualRisks.title: Every journey has desktop and mobile proof
residualRisks.residualRisk: Existing screenshots or manual notes are not commit-bound executable evidence.

residualRisks.title: Synthetic user journeys continuously measure SLOs
residualRisks.residualRisk: User-visible failures may not page before clients notice.

residualRisks.title: Scale, burst, and soak scenarios pass
residualRisks.residualRisk: Capacity limits and failure thresholds remain unknown.

residualRisks.title: Journey latency and responsiveness budgets pass
residualRisks.residualRisk: No production-like latency evidence enforces the declared budgets.

residualRisks.title: Provider failover and portability are contract-tested
residualRisks.residualRisk: Provider-specific assumptions can strand media or prevent failover.

residualRisks.title: SSO, MFA, lifecycle, and session policy are certified
residualRisks.residualRisk: Enterprise identity assurance remains unverified.

nextHighestRisk.title: Public links are private, immutable, permission-enforced, revocable, and usable on mobile and desktop
nextHighestRisk.residualRisk: A public or mutable link can expose original media or change beneath a client decision.
